alts: Droopy Climber teal overhead ladder climber with side ladders and bird figure

data.description: A red bird perched on the top bar gives the Droopy Climber its character. Below it, a teal overhead ladder with triangular hand grips spans two upright frames, each with a ladder for getting up and down. Children grab the triangles one after another to move across, which builds grip and upper-body strength, and the bird gives younger ones something to point at and talk about. The product area is 11'2" x 3', narrow enough for the side of a society garden, and the safe play area is 16'2" x 8'. It is finished in Horizon Teal. Its galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope are covered by our 3-year warranty. For a red and yellow option, see the Crest Climber, or ask us for a layout and quote.

props.pText: Galvanised uprights carry the overhead ladder and are grouted or installed self-standing to suit the soil. Check the hand grips and the fixing of the bird figure at each service visit. Rubber flooring under the full run of grips is the right surface, because children will drop from the bars. Keep the 16'2" x 8' zone free of benches.
